'''wishtaun''' was the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] ID of a user on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. wishtaun was among a number of users that posted comments in the forum in response to a recently published story in which a character called [[Nightwing]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] a [[Thaereian military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]].<ref name="EAC" />
